title: Start at the browser entry
description: index.html restores the saved theme before src/main.jsx mounts App. App owns four hash routes; unknown hashes resolve to home.

title: Follow shared navigation and theme
description: Header and Footer consume static route labels. Hash anchors avoid a routing dependency; native details provides the mobile menu.

title: Trace static content into pages
description: content.js provides catalog objects, documentation tuples and ecosystem stages. Home selects featured material; products filter by category. No backend or checkout flow is implemented here.

title: Understand scroll-driven storytelling
description: EcosystemStory schedules scroll updates with requestAnimationFrame; getStoryState clamps progress and chooses a stage. Mobile cards use IntersectionObserver.

title: Inspect native dialogs and team navigation
description: Documentation uses a native image dialog. AboutPage adds team hotspots, profile navigation, close animation and focus restoration; descriptions are placeholders.

title: Separate intended content from shipped routes
description: package.json contains Vite commands and a story assertion script. PAGE_CONTENT.md lists more sections than App currently routes; README contains only the project title.
